tests.name: Official BIG WPPNRI 573 Geometry Validation
tests.evidence: Acquired via official BIG MapServer REST Layer 21; Valid geometry with 625,698 vertices; Area = 933,749.49 km2; Identical to data/boundaries/wppnri_573_big.geojson

tests.name: Temporal Domain Completeness (2015-01 to 2025-12)
tests.evidence: 132 fixed calendar months established. OISST, CFSv2, and HYCOM cover 100% (132/132). MODIS-Aqua L3SMI covers 131/132 months (Dec 2025 requires gap-fill mitigation).

tests.name: Thermal Front Gradient Formulation in °C/km
tests.evidence: Replaced arbitrary /4.63 divisor with spherical metric gradient (dLat_km = 111.0, dLon_km = 111.32 * cos(lat)).

tests.name: Ekman Transport Physical Units and Latitude Damping
tests.evidence: Formulation M_ey = -tau_x / (rho_w * f) in m2/s with Coriolis damping parameter f = 2*Omega*sin(lat) and low-latitude cutoff |lat| >= 2.0°.

tests.name: Existing Baseline Preservation Integrity
tests.evidence: All Phase 1-4.1.1 baseline files, weights, and fisheries datasets untouched (15/15 regression tests preserved).
